_what: A day's slate. Every candidate is something you could bet, with YOUR probability attached. Jordan ranks them, picks one to forecast, and decides separately whether it is a bet.
_known: Checklist keys you have actually checked. Run `python3 -m jordan checklist nfl` to see them all. What you leave out raises the edge Jordan demands before betting.

candidates.notes: cover prob from de-vigged ML minus the 1/2/3 margin mass
